Text: President Donald Trump will award medals to several prominent technology executives at the “Science: A New Golden Age Summit” on Thursday, including Elon Musk, Michael Dell, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Google co-founder Sergey Brin. The White House said the recipients are helping keep the U.S. at the forefront of technological innovation. The summit comes just over a week after Trump hosted a White House meeting with AI leaders, where he said he had signed a “morally binding” agreement with tech executives amid growing debate over slowing AI development.
